voip.title: VoIP Platform - MNSCloud
voip.heading: VoIP Platform
voip.lead: Manage PABX, Softswitch, DID inventory, routing, recordings, media files, and WebRTC readiness through a multi-tenant API-first architecture.
items: PABX servers, accounts, trunks, routing, queues, IVR, and media files.
Softswitch providers, resources, subscribers, DID, and routing.
SBC and WebRTC edge architecture for secure registration.
Storage-backed recordings and public client integrations.
voip.ctaTitle: Enable voice operations without exposing private control-plane logic.

hosting.title: Hosting Automation - MNSCloud
hosting.heading: Hosting Automation
hosting.lead: Provision and manage VPS, VPS Container, DNS, storage, SMTP, and web hosting services with provider catalogs and tenant-aware operational workflows.
items: VPS providers, plans, images, regions, and instances.
VPS Container providers, plans, and Incus-first instances.
DNS, storage accounts, SMTP providers, routes, and web hosting.
Provider APIs stay server-side; public clients only consume safe API contracts.
hosting.ctaTitle: Automate infrastructure without leaking provider authority.

monitoring.title: Monitoring And Agents - MNSCloud
monitoring.heading: Monitoring And Agents
monitoring.lead: Track server health, agent heartbeat, capabilities, assignments, job history, and operational activity through outbound-only Linux agents.
items: Communication is initiated from the server to the API.
No external inbound agent port is required by default.
Capabilities declare what the server can do; the API decides what it may do.
Job execution and status are auditable in the control plane.
monitoring.ctaTitle: Operate remote servers through controlled, auditable jobs.

cyberSecurity.title: Cyber Security - MNSCloud
cyberSecurity.heading: Cyber Security
cyberSecurity.lead: Service-based protection profiles, CrowdSec intelligence, nftables enforcement, alerts, decisions, allowlists, blocklists, and agent-driven installation.
items: Profiles are based on services such as SSH, Nginx, Asterisk, Kamailio, and MariaDB.
Firewall enforcement uses nftables with CrowdSec decisions.
Agents report status and job history back to the platform.
Public installers do not hold customer secrets or private policy authority.
cyberSecurity.ctaTitle: Build security posture from services, not from fragile server labels.

support.title: Support And CRM - MNSCloud
support.heading: Support And CRM
support.lead: Connect support, CRM, sales, and customer context so operational teams can move from ticket handling to commercial follow-up without losing visibility.
items: Tickets, channels, teams, and service queues.
CRM leads, opportunities, and pipeline tracking.
Sales catalog, products, brands, stock, quotations, and categories.
Tenant-aware customer data controlled by the API.
support.ctaTitle: Keep customer operations close to the infrastructure that serves them.
